---
title: "Experiment Reliability Analyzer"
author: "Kayson Mirain"
output: html_document
---

## Research question

Which product experiments provide reliable evidence of conversion lift after accounting for sampling uncertainty, assignment balance, and multiple comparisons?

## Experimental design

The generator creates three seeded randomized experiments with user, device, acquisition-channel, conversion, and revenue outcomes. Each analysis verifies the control/treatment allocation, estimates absolute and relative lift, and reports adjusted business outcomes.

## Evaluation

The analysis reports two-proportion tests, non-parametric bootstrap confidence intervals, Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values, sample-ratio mismatch checks, and future sample-size estimates. A logistic model tests whether experiment effects persist after adjustment for device, returning-user status, and acquisition channel.

```{r results, echo=FALSE}
inference <- read.csv("../results/experiment_inference.csv")
knitr::kable(inference, digits = 4)
```

## Reproduction

Run `make all` from the repository root. Assignment generation is seeded, every statistical decision is scripted, and inference tables and the adjusted model summary are saved under `results/`.
